# Node.js Instructions

Use `.github/skills/node-development/SKILL.md` for Node.js backend, CLI, service, library, and runtime package work.

Resolve the owning package, workspace, package manager, framework, and validation commands from repository evidence. JavaScript/TypeScript extensions and package filenames are routing hints only; do not activate a Node framework or invent a command without manifest, configuration, script, target, or CI evidence.

For browser-facing React, Next.js, Angular, or other frontend work, also apply `.github/skills/web-frontend-development/SKILL.md` and keep frontend scope separate from Node runtime scope. Use `.github/skills/web-frontend-development/references/validation-output.md` for validation result fields and statuses.
